candidate_evidence.quote: After completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy, participants will receive adjuvant temozolomide combined with sintilimab and bevacizumab.

role_evidence.quote: Sintilimab 200 mg will be administered by intravenous infusion once every 21 days for up to 1 year as part of enhanced adjuvant therapy after completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

flag.reason: Role depends on whether bevacizumab (established GBM therapy, new setting) counts as a second investigational agent; sintilimab is a candidate either way (monotherapy vs combination).

role_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg will be administered by intravenous infusion once every 21 days for up to 1 year as part of enhanced adjuvant therapy after completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

flag.reason: Established GBM therapy given in a new setting (newly diagnosed, with PD-1 antibody); could instead be an experimental_combination candidate.

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide will be administered concurrently with postoperative radiotherapy for approximately 28 days

coder_notes: Single-arm; sintilimab + bevacizumab added to Stupp-type chemoradiotherapy with boosted radiation dose. Bevacizumab role is a judgement call (rule 6 vs rule 5).
